title: The Anatomy of an AI Agent
author: Lilian Weng
why_read_this: A foundational overview of how LLM-powered autonomous agents work. Essential for Principal PMs designing agentic systems to understand planning, memory, and tool use.

title: Generative AI: A Creative New World
author: Sequoia Capital
why_read_this: Provides a high-level strategic framework for the GenAI application landscape. Helps you formulate product strategies in a rapidly evolving market.

title: Attention Is All You Need
author: Ashish Vaswani et al.
why_read_this: The seminal paper introducing the Transformer architecture. Reading this helps PMs build deep intuition for how modern LLMs actually process information.
